home.title: Riads & Beachfront Rentals in Asilah, Morocco
home.description: Discover handpicked riads, beachfront apartments and medina houses in Asilah, Morocco. Book seasonal rentals, view prices and contact us on WhatsApp.
home.heroSub: Handpicked riads, medina houses and beachfront apartments across Morocco's northern coast — sourced, managed and loved by people who live here.
home.townCopy: A fortified medina of lime-washed walls, cobalt doors and hand-painted murals, set against one of Morocco's most walkable beaches. This is the Asilah we know best — and the one we'd love to open up for you.
home.featuredCopy: A rotating shortlist chosen by our local team — each one visited, photographed and verified before it reaches your screen.
home.whyCopy: We are a small Asilah team, not a faceless platform. Every listing is walked through, every price is a conversation.
home.verifiedCopy: Each property is physically checked, ownership is confirmed and photos are taken on-site — no stock, no surprises.
home.expertsCopy: A season-round team on the ground in the medina and the beachfront — showing homes, managing stays and resolving issues within hours.
home.bookingCopy: Transparent contracts, secure payments and a single friendly point of contact from first message to final handover.
home.visitCopy: Our office sits a two-minute walk from Bab Al Kasbah. Drop by for coffee, a walk-through of the port, or to see a home before anyone else does.
home.testimonialsCopy: Owners, tenants and buyers — a few of the hundreds who found their place through our team.
home.answers24h: Answers within 24 hours · English, Arabic & French
home.heroImgAlt: The shoreline of Asilah stretching toward the Atlantic

about.title: About Us
about.description: Asilah Real Estate — a trusted agency in Asilah, Morocco since 2015. Your partner for buying, selling and renting properties on the Atlantic coast.
about.subtitle: Your trusted partner in Asilah's real estate market since 2015
about.p1: Premium real estate agency in Asilah, offering exceptional properties and rental services across Northern Morocco.
about.p2: Our deep understanding of the local market, combined with professional management practices, allows us to offer unparalleled service to property owners and tenants alike.
about.p3: We specialize in rental properties, from beachfront apartments to traditional Moroccan riads, ensuring each property is managed with the utmost care and professionalism.
about.mission: To provide exceptional real estate services that connect people with their perfect properties in Asilah, ensuring transparent, professional, and hassle-free experiences for property owners and tenants.
about.vision: To become the most trusted and innovative real estate platform in Northern Morocco, setting new standards for property management and client satisfaction.

stats.heading1: A quiet decade of helping people

testimonials.t1: They looked after my riad in the medina all last season — key handovers, clean-ups, guests sorted over WhatsApp. I only came back to collect the rent.
testimonials.t2: Found a beachfront flat for the summer two weeks before I flew in. What I saw in the photos is exactly what I got.
testimonials.t3: Bought a house near Rmel Bay through them. They walked me through the paperwork in French and Arabic and stayed with it until the keys were in my hand.
testimonials.t4: We came from Rabat for one weekend, saw three homes in a morning and had an answer the same evening. Months later they still call to see how we're settling in.
